build_quadruped_robot: build a QuadrupedBase robot instance with a PyBullet client, clock, motor control mode, and motor limits
load_urdf_pose: load the quadruped URDF with a configured base position, orientation quaternion, and joint angles
reset_robot_pose: reset the quadruped robot base position, orientation, and joint angles without reloading the URDF
step_simulation: step the quadruped simulation by applying an action and advancing the physics for a number of sub steps
compute_foot_contact_forces: compute the contact forces on all quadruped feet using PyBullet contact point data and kinematics
